abstract: A 26-year-old primigravida patient was referred with suspicion of ectopic pregnancy 39 days after her last menstrual period. Her serum β-human chorionic gonadotropin value was 3812 mIU/mL. As we suspected the existence of ectopic pregnancy with bilateral dermoid cysts, laparoendoscopic single-site surgery was performed. After dissection of dense pelvic adhesion, cystectomy was performed for a left ovarian dermoid cyst. Although there was a right ovary at the correct position, a parasitic dermoid cyst firmly attached to the peritoneal surface of cul-de-sac was identified. After excision of the parasitic dermoid cyst, early abdominal pregnancy tissue implanted in the peritoneal hollow of right deep pararectal space was identified under the guidance of diffusion-weighted magnetic resonance imaging and was excised. With systemic administration of methotorexate, the postoperative course was uneventful.
abstract_ja: 26歳の初妊婦が、最終月経から39日目に子宮外妊娠の疑いで紹介された。血清ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)値は3812 mIU/mLであった。両側の類皮嚢腫を伴う子宮外妊娠が疑われたため、単孔式腹腔鏡手術を施行した。密な骨盤内癒着を剥離した後、左卵巣類皮嚢腫に対して嚢腫摘出術を行った。右卵巣は正常な位置にあったが、ダグラス窩の腹膜面に強固に付着した寄生性類皮嚢腫が同定された。寄生性類皮嚢腫を切除後、右深部直腸傍窩の腹腔内に着床した初期腹腔妊娠の組織が、拡散強調磁気共鳴画像法(MRI)の誘導下に同定され、切除された。メトトレキサートの全身投与を併用し、術後経過は良好であった。
